leasePolicy.start: Only after root grants an exclusive Chrome turn.
leasePolicy.serialization: Acquire /tmp/roadster-playtest-input.lock atomically before every CUA call; release after each call. Never remove another owner’s lock.
leasePolicy.scope: Own new game tab only; do not resume, reload, replace or close the existing paused order tabs.
leasePolicy.input: Only supported CUA visible controls. No hidden game state, teleport, engine stepping or autopilot.

sequence: Create a fresh game tab after the explicit lease; ordinary Play then Search an area for Hayathnagar and choose the exact visible result. If unavailable, use exact Ghatkesar search result; do not invent a location or inject coordinates.

Record initial spawn screenshot, area, HUD, viewport and offer. Compare approach versus pickup-to-customer distances and after-collection timer wording. Dismiss an obstructing tutorial using its visible close button.
Before acceptance, open the full map using the visible minimap; press actual Close map and verify return to gameplay. Record failure state rather than assuming a successful click.

Prefer a short plausible offer. Use Another at most three times if approach exceeds roughly 500 m, then take the practical visible offer or record the long approach limitation. Accept explicitly and record the exact route.

Drive with short W/A/D/S holds, typically 0.3–3 s, taking fresh visible state after each maneuver. Follow roads and document actual named areas/streets, route changes, moving traffic and any naturally encountered median. Do not convert incidental curb contact into a confirmed geometry defect.

If explicit collection prompt is reached, stop and hold E, capture collection toast and Deliver HUD. Continue customer leg only while lease permits; explicit award is required to count a completed delivery.

If handover completes, observe a normal unpaused next offer as the control to the prior immediate-pause success. If flight becomes useful, use earned boost and record flight/descent guidance separately from ground route distance.

If stuck, use the normal visible recovery control once and record before/after clearance and departure. Pause/resume once to verify the accepted order remains. Do not pursue a repeated blocker without reporting it.

Save original screenshots through the provided local helper, capture warn/error console, and record explicit held-input ledger and counts. Pause and mark an unfinished order as handoff; close completed/no-order test tab. Reset any viewport override, release input/lock, close helper and announce browser free.
